kind: Exploratory modern compatibility build framebuffer export; not original-release certification

capture.method: Cinder copyWindowSurface after draw 30, then writeImage PNG

reproduction: Reconstruct reference/native/modern with its rebuild.py into /tmp/gel-native-lossless-probe (must be a fresh directory).
Apply capture.patch in the reconstructed source; reconfigure CMake to apply the distinct bundle identifier, then rebuild.
Launch build/Gelbox.app; draw 30 writes /tmp/gel-native-lossless-probe/startup.png. The probe has a fixed output path and should remain disposable.
limitations: Modern compatibility patches and Cinder version remain different from original release.
PNG is tagged sRGB by writer; relationship between framebuffer bytes, original-release framebuffer and display-managed capture requires validation.
Only startup captured; no repeatability or full-scene parity certification.
Capture instrumentation is absent from the original release and both main checkouts.
